name: (Martial Artist) Blazing Gate
text:
Requirements The grandmaster has a target Grabbed or Restrained

---
Effect The grandmaster tosses their target upwards and electrocutes them with a qi-infused double palm strike as they land. The target becomes Prone, loses the grabbed or restrained condition, and takes 5d6 bludgeoning damage and 2d8 persistent electricity damage (DC 38 basic Fortitude save save).
